Precision Racing Components LLC is based in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company is led by President Chris Sumner. A founding year is not publicly disclosed, and ownership details have not been specified.

The company designs and manufactures dry sump oil pumps and complete oil system solutions for motorsports applications. Its product line includes sprint car oil pumps, late model oil pumps, pulley drive oil pumps, and sump mounted oil pumps. Precision machining capabilities support the production of engine accessory kits, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Precision Racing Components serves championship winning race teams and manufacturers worldwide. Its customer base spans professional motorsports series and automotive manufacturers seeking custom oil system packaging and performance.

The company emphasizes a passion for excellence and decades of experience, aiming to help customers win races and championships. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and works closely with clients to tailor oil systems to specific performance and packaging requirements.

name: Precision Technical Molding
old_description: We offer support from concept to production, ensuring a smooth process. Our team is dedicated to realizing your ideas with expertise. Let us help bring your vision to life.
about:
Precision Technical Molding was founded in 2016 in Green Valley, Arizona, beginning with a single injection molding machine. The company operates under the PTM/Grupo Selagon group, maintaining a U.S. warehouse in Nogales, Arizona, and a manufacturing facility in Cibuta, Sonora, Mexico.

The company provides plastic injection molding services from prototype to production volumes, supported by 14 machines with clamping forces ranging from 50 to 350 tons. Capabilities include clean room injection and assembly, mold design and construction, product design optimization, and prototype and production tooling. The Mexican facility handles manufacturing, while the Nogales warehouse supports U.S. distribution.

PTM serves the medical device sector, evidenced by ISO 13485 certification and experience with FDA audits, IQ/OQ/PQ validations, and PPAP. A noted customer is Zobele, whose sourcing specialist praised the company's performance. The company also works with international clients, shipping from Mexico to the United States and other locations.

The company states its mission is the "endless pursuit of molding perfection," emphasizing innovation to reduce costs and enhance performance, service to meet molding and manufacturing needs, and quality as a top priority. It highlights competitive pricing, extensive industry experience, and RJG Master Molder II expertise as differentiators.

name: Precision Wire Technologies
old_description: Alloys: Nichrome, Nickel Iron, Nickel Copper, Bronze, Stainless Steel, and More
about:
Precision Wire Technologies operates from Fort Wayne, Indiana, where it has been drawing fine and ultra-fine wire for nearly 30 years. The company began as a specialist in fine wire drawing and has since expanded into resistance wire manufacturing and custom drawing services. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed in public materials.

The company produces wire in diameters ranging from 0.0011 inch (49 gauge) to 0.102 inch (10 gauge) across a broad alloy portfolio that includes Nichrome, nickel-iron, nickel-copper, bronze, stainless steel, brass, Monel, iron-chrome-aluminum, nickel-chrome, nickel-plated steel, and pure nickel. Services encompass fine wire drawing, resistance wire manufacturing, straight-and-cut wire in lengths from 1 to 144 inches, and custom drawing projects for difficult specifications. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Precision Wire Technologies does not explicitly list target industries or customer types on its website. Its alloy wire and custom drawing capabilities suggest applications in electronics, aerospace, medical devices, and industrial heating, but no specific sectors or named clients are provided in the available information.

The company emphasizes tight tolerances and short lead times as key differentiators, along with customized stocking strategies and a willingness to take on drawing projects that other suppliers decline. Its central U.S. location and relationships with multiple alloy suppliers are cited as advantages for material availability and delivery speed.

name: Preferred Data Voice Networks
old_description: Established in Baton Rouge, Louisiana in 1980, we are a highly experienced company.
about:
Preferred Data Voice Networks was founded in 1980 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and has operated as a family-owned communications provider for over four decades. The company began as a local vendor serving businesses across the state with voice and data networking solutions.

The firm specializes in the design and installation of structured cabling systems, including Category 3, 5, and 6 plenum and non-plenum copper as well as fiber optic infrastructure. Its factory-trained technicians handle projects ranging from a few cables for small office moves to several hundred cables for large-scale deployments. Beyond cabling, PDVN delivers hosted and premise-based VoIP phone systems, remote-worker solutions, call recording and documentation platforms, headsets, conference phones, automatic call distribution for contact centers, internet connectivity options, and paging systems.

Customers span small businesses to larger enterprises throughout Louisiana, with the company positioning itself as a local alternative to national carriers. A recent appearance by team member Melissa Asevedo on WRKF's Out to Lunch podcast highlights its community engagement.

PDVN emphasizes that its family-owned structure allows it to design systems that grow with a client's business while reducing costs, a philosophy reflected in its long-standing presence in the Baton Rouge market.

Preferred Plastics Inc. operates a 15,000-square-foot facility in Shiner, Texas, supplying performance plastic and metal products to construction, agricultural, industrial, automotive, and oilfield markets. In-house capabilities include CNC milling, CNC turning, plastic and metal welding, fabrication, and plating, allowing the shop to produce welded plastic assemblies, plated and welded metal assemblies, and custom-designed components. The facility stocks more than 200 material grades and offers same-day shipping on stocked items, supporting both one-off prototypes and production runs.

Customers span heavy equipment, oilfield services, agricultural machinery, automotive suppliers, and general industrial manufacturers. The company emphasizes transparent supply-chain communication, helping clients avoid material shortages and maintain production schedules.

Preferred Plastics differentiates itself through bespoke service, cutting-edge equipment, and a commitment to accessibility—expediting orders to meet urgent timelines while providing material certifications and design collaboration from concept through installation.

name: Premier Electronics
old_description: We specialize in providing Tier 1 capabilities and quality with the customer attention and flexibility of a dynamic manufacturing partner.
about:
Electronics operates from Sugar Land, Texas, providing electronics manufacturing services. The company has been in operation since at least 2016, as indicated by its copyright notice, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been published.

The shop runs two high-speed Samsung SMT lines that have sextupled capacity over the past year, supporting both prototype and production volumes. Core processes include surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly with exotic component placement, chassis and box builds, cable and wire harness fabrication, panel assembly, system integration, potting, and conformal coating. Additional value-added services encompass MRP-based production planning, supply chain management, order fulfillment, and third-party inventory stocking.

Customers span oil and gas, ruggedized commercial devices, medical, police and military peripherals, and security cameras for school districts. A purchasing manager at an industrial gas company noted that the firm grew from a single part number to become their largest supplier over a decade.

positions itself as a Tier 1-capable partner that combines advanced equipment with flexible scheduling to accelerate onshoring and reduce total cost. Its differentiators include FCA (Chrysler) approval, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and RoHS-compliant assembly for 98 percent of output.

about:
Improvements Solar operates from West Hartford, Connecticut, where it has served residential customers for over two decades. The company is veteran-owned, with owner Brian a team that includes project managers, installers, and customer-service representatives. Founded on a passion for solar energy, the business began as a local installer focused on helping Connecticut homeowners reduce rising electricity costs.

The firm provides turnkey solar energy systems: custom-designed photovoltaic installations, battery backup storage using FranklinWH A2 and Tesla Powerwall units, and full roof replacement using Owens Corning Duration® shingles with WeatherLock® protection. It also offers combined roof-and-solar packages and assists customers with CT Green Bank Smart-E Loan financing. To date, the company has completed more than 1,000 solar installations across the state.

Improvements Solar works exclusively with homeowners throughout Connecticut, delivering residential solar power, energy storage, and roofing solutions. Its customer base includes families seeking to lower utility bills, achieve energy independence during grid outages, and take advantage of state incentives such as battery rebates up to $16,000.

The company emphasizes its veteran-owned status, 25-year comprehensive warranties on equipment and workmanship, and a no-pressure sales approach. As an approved Smart-E Loan provider and a certified installer for both Tesla Powerwall and FranklinWH systems, it positions itself as a single-source partner for home energy upgrades.

name: Prescott Metal
old_description: Join the Prescott Metal team and be part of a company known as one of the best custom sheet-metal fabricators in New England, and one that has been an anchor business in Biddeford since 1918.
about:
Prescott Metal operates from Biddeford, Maine, where it has been an anchor business since its founding in 1918. The company remains a second-generation family-owned operation, now running a 5,000-square-foot facility dedicated to sheet metal fabrication

The shop provides full-service precision sheet metal fabrication, including laser cutting, punching, forming on seven Amada press brakes (4' to 10'), welding, frame fabrication, CNC turning, CNC milling, and waterjet cutting. An in-house engineering team uses SolidWorks 3D CAD for design-for-manufacturability support, and finishing capabilities encompass powder coating with iron phosphate pretreatment and silk screening. Value-added assembly and delivery round out the offering.

Prescott Metal serves customers across New England requiring custom sheet metal components and frames. While the company does not publicize specific industry verticals, its capabilities align with sectors such as industrial equipment, electronics enclosures, and structural frames.

The company attributes its longevity to a "Quality Work by Quality People" philosophy, emphasizing workforce development and a commitment to domestic manufacturing. As a second-generation family business, it highlights its deep roots in the Biddeford community and its ability to handle projects from prototype through production.

name: Pretium Packaging
old_description: Learn more about the values that make Pretium Packaging a leader in sustainable packaging.
about:
Pretium Packaging is headquartered in Peru, Illinois. The company operates as a designer and manufacturer of rigid packaging solutions. Public sources do not disclose a founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company provides full-service design and manufacturing of rigid packaging for specialized applications, focusing on small to mid-sized production volumes. Its capabilities include custom molding, printed folding cartons through its Ediprint division, and an Innovation Center near Chicago offering single-cavity prototyping, design collaboration rooms, and market simulation shelves. Pretium operates 26 locations across five countries, employs approximately 2,800 associates, maintains 2,100 stock molds, offers 875 custom colors, and launches about 110 new products annually.

Pretium serves a broad range of industries requiring rigid packaging. and Canadian Drug Master Files for pharmaceutical packaging. The company uses only FDA-approved raw materials and supports HACCP plans.

Pretium differentiates itself through a flexible manufacturing network with redundant tooling and over 2,000 stock options for faster delivery, a dedicated innovation team and lab for rapid prototyping, a sustainability program that includes vegetable inks and FSC-certified cardboard, and a quality system featuring in-house leak detection, metal detection, vision inspection, and SPC data collection calibrated to NIST standards.

name: Prime Energy Services LLC
old_description: Keep your home solar system operating at peak performance with inspections, repairs, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
about:
Prime Energy Services LLC is based in Milford, Connecticut, and was founded in 2006. The company has over 20 years of experience in the renewable energy industry, serving homeowners and businesses throughout Connecticut.

The company provides a range of solar energy services including system inspections, performance evaluations, inverter troubleshooting, monitoring system repairs, panel replacement, critter guard installation, wiring inspections, panel removal and reinstallation, and preventative maintenance programs for both residential and commercial properties. It also maintains, diagnoses, and optimizes battery storage systems for backup power and energy independence.

Prime Energy Services works with residential and commercial solar system owners across Connecticut. Its technicians service systems regardless of who originally installed them, addressing the needs of customers whose original installers are no longer available.

The company emphasizes education, transparency, and innovation, aiming to help customers understand the value of solar power. Its team focuses on identifying issues early, minimizing downtime, and maximizing long-term energy production to protect customers' solar investments.
